title: Uniform Fourier basis on three points
statement: The real-valued functions on $\{a,b,c\}$ have a basis indexed by $\{0,1,2\}$ whose vector at index $0$ is the constant function $1$. With respect to the uniform probability distribution on $\{a,b,c\}$, the basis vectors are orthonormal: the expectation of the product of the vectors at indices $a$ and $b$ is $1$ if $a=b$ and $0$ otherwise.
